title: Hillview Haven with Fenced Yard
description:
Enjoy a cozy fall getaway with TN Hill Views from the front & back porches! A perfect mid-term home for traveling professionals, just minutes from shopping, grocery stores, medical centers, Old Hickory Lake, restaurants, parks, & a quick drive to Nashville. Fully furnished with high-end linens, towels & bedding, plus a huge fenced backyard. Pet friendly & ready for move-in! Special pricing available for insurance & temporary housing guests.

The space
Bliss Road Offers 5 Star Properties,
Fully Furnished with all Amenities,
High End Towels/Linens/ and Bedding.

Every home has a starter kit stocked with paper products, including paper towels and toilet paper, as well as coffee supplies!

Guest access
Guests can enjoy whole house. It is reserved for paid overnight guests only.

Other things to note
**Traveling with pets? We’re happy to welcome your furry friends! 

Please note there is a pet fee of $150 per pet, with a maximum of 2 pets per stay. This fee will be charged as your reservation is confirmed. 

Let us know in advance if you’ll be bringing a pet so we can ensure everything is ready for a comfortable stay, for both you and your companions! **
